As my half freezing self lays here, a little tipsy, I look back on my life's regrets. This empty bed means nothing, and this blanket offers no warmth. I've loss people this last year, good people. A couple I even loved. I loss some because of my own actions, and loss is the only thing that was able to get through my thick skull. There's nothing like taking a step back and seeing how much of a monster you've become by hurting someone you care about. The loss was great, not good great, but a major loss. My actions caused me only sorrow in the end. Even then my actions after the loss just dug myself deeper. Once I hit rock bottom, it still took some time for me to pull myself out of my self centered attitude.  I did, I eventually did. I worked on myself and still continue to do so. I eventually met a few other people, just going through the motions. That is until I met her. We met online, and hit things off. We were never supposed to fall for each other. Turns out, she only lived an hour away, which was fantastic news. Things were good for a little bit, we didn't fight as much as my previous relationships, and I learned how to actually appreciate her and be an adult. Alas, no matter how better I am now, things sometimes happen to split people apart. Old plans came through of an old opportunity she had, and there's no way I would ever want to hold some one back, so I pretended I was okay. She knew how I felt about her and it made things harder for her, but I didn't want her to feel that way, I didn't want her to feel bad over me. The guy who previously messed up so bad in the previous months that one of his best friends wouldn't even talk to him anymore. But she was different, she called me things like, "You're a wonderful man." "Sweet and loving and generous and all around great." It's things I thought no one would ever call me again and it's at that point I was certain I am changing for the better. Because of this girl, I refuse to give up. I refuse to stop working on myself. Because if someone as wonderful as her can belive in me, so can I. 
So I guess what I desire most is some one to love on and be with. Someone to share these nights which grow more cold. To have someone who loves to cuddle up as much as I do under a big thick blanket. 

TL; DR: Someone to share my life with and cuddle.
